summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) by Li Bang International Corp Inc. to increase its at-the-market (ATM) offering capacity from $20M to $60M of Class A ordinary shares, with $9.3M already sold as of April 1, 2026. The filing amends a prior sales agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC as agent, adding $40M in additional shares. Shares trade on Nasdaq under LBGJ (last price $1.18). This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM facility amendment, not a special situation.
